description: SOLUTION_VALIDATION with contradictory evidence: an enthusiastic champion, an unconvinced finance lead.

activities.title: Discovery
activities.outcome_notes: Liam: pickers walk too much; two warehouses, peak season in November.

activities.title: Technical workshop
activities.outcome_notes: Integration with the WMS confirmed feasible by their IT.

activities.title: Demo to Liam and Nadia
activities.transcript: Liam: This is exactly what we need, the team loved it. Nadia: I am not convinced yet. The other vendor quoted a lower price and I have not seen how the savings are measured. Liam: We can run a test on one aisle.

pain.summary: Pickers walk too far between locations

blocker.summary: The finance director has not seen how the savings are measured

manager_notes: Liam is enthusiastic but Nadia decides; do not mistake the champion for the buyer.
